hypothesis: Native source image scale limits small-object grounding before 3D writing; retain each viewport observation domain to prevent invented global negatives.

fixed.identity: same detector-conditioned native filter after combined evidence

promotion: Require material complete-cohort benefit in both readouts without severe part/identity regression; no per-query assembly; no SOTA/novelty claim from added evidence alone.

references.title: SAHI: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference and Fine-tuning for Small Object Detection
references.relevance: Image slicing is an existing capability, not claimed as new contribution.

references.title: Official SAM3 image processor
references.relevance: Source crop masks are probabilities in masks_logits; retained local code inspected before projection.

direct_identity_control.inputs: original full-image detections, original query encodings/native map and identity density rule
direct_identity_control.intervention: encode actual detection mask instead of nearest cached SAM region; no added detections
direct_identity_control.score: unchanged one-vs-two model-averaged native identity posterior
direct_identity_control.budget: one additional SigLIP vision crop per nonempty original detection
direct_identity_control.context_scope_rule: Expanded context only affects identity encoding; never expands foreground labels or allowed extent
direct_identity_control.predicted_failure: Masked part may lose identifying parent context; context may confuse nearby objects. Reject if full-cohort response/selection tradeoff or severe regression.

next_mechanism: Unknown identity and finite evidence strength before replacing native field; sparse-view posterior and selected-set regularization must be validated jointly. No more crop-size or context-scale sweeps.
